parameters.formDescription: Das Bild wird auf allen beaufsichtigten iPads als Sperr- und Home-Bildschirm gesetzt und kann dort nicht geaendert werden.

parameters.query: UPDATE automation.profile_state SET params = jsonb_set(params, '{IMAGE_B64}', to_jsonb($1::text)), version = version + 1, updated_at = now() WHERE name = 'wallpaper' RETURNING version

WITH claimed AS (
  INSERT INTO automation.device_profile AS d (enrollment_id, profile_name, version, state, claimed_at)
  SELECT e.id, p.name, p.version, 'claimed', now()
  FROM public.enrollments e CROSS JOIN automation.profile_state p
  WHERE e.type = 'Device' AND e.enabled AND p.name IN ('wallpaper', 'wallpaper-lock') AND p.enabled
  ON CONFLICT (enrollment_id, profile_name) DO UPDATE
    SET version = EXCLUDED.version, state = 'claimed', claimed_at = now(), command_uuid = NULL, sent_at = NULL
    WHERE d.version < EXCLUDED.version OR d.state IN ('failed', 'error')
  RETURNING d.enrollment_id, d.profile_name, d.version
)
SELECT c.enrollment_id, c.profile_name, c.version, p.kind, p.template, p.params
FROM claimed c JOIN automation.profile_state p ON p.name = c.profile_name

parameters.jsCode:
const crypto = require('crypto');
const claimed = $input.all().map((item) => item.json).filter((row) => row.profile_name);
if (claimed.length === 0) return [{ json: { skip: true } }];
const escapeXml = (value) => String(value)
  .replace(/&/g, '&')
  .replace(/</g, '<')
  .replace(/>/g, '>')
  .replace(/"/g, '"');
return claimed.map((row) => {
  const params = typeof row.params === 'string' ? JSON.parse(row.params) : row.params;
  let profile = row.template;
  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(params)) {
    const text = Array.isArray(value)
      ? value.map((item) => '				<string>' + escapeXml(item) + '</string>').join('
')
      : escapeXml(value);
    profile = profile.split('__' + key + '__').join(text);
  }
  profile = profile.split('__VERSION__').join(String(row.version));
  const commandUuid = crypto.randomUUID();
  if (row.kind === 'wallpaper') {
    const settings = '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
'
      + '<!DOCTYPE plist PUBLIC "-//Apple//DTD PLIST 1.0//EN" "http://www.apple.com/DTDs/PropertyList-1.0.dtd">
'
      + '<plist version="1.0">
<dict>
	<key>Command</key>
	<dict>
		<key>RequestType</key>
		<string>Settings</string>
'
      + '		<key>Settings</key>
		<array>
			<dict>
				<key>Image</key>
				<data>' + params.IMAGE_B64 + '</data>
'
      + '				<key>Item</key>
				<string>Wallpaper</string>
'
      + '				<key>Where</key>
				<integer>' + Number(params.WHERE || 3) + '</integer>
			</dict>
		</array>
'
      + '	</dict>
	<key>CommandUUID</key>
	<string>' + commandUuid + '</string>
</dict>
</plist>
';
    return { json: { skip: false, enrollment_id: row.enrollment_id, profile_name: row.profile_name, version: row.version, command_uuid: commandUuid, plist: settings } };
  }
  const plist = '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
'
    + '<!DOCTYPE plist PUBLIC "-//Apple//DTD PLIST 1.0//EN" "http://www.apple.com/DTDs/PropertyList-1.0.dtd">
'
    + '<plist version="1.0">
<dict>
	<key>Command</key>
	<dict>
		<key>Payload</key>
		<data>'
    + Buffer.from(profile, 'utf8').toString('base64')
    + '</data>
		<key>RequestType</key>
		<string>InstallProfile</string>
	</dict>
	<key>CommandUUID</key>
	<string>'
    + commandUuid + '</string>
</dict>
</plist>
';
  return { json: { skip: false, enrollment_id: row.enrollment_id, profile_name: row.profile_name, version: row.version, command_uuid: commandUuid, plist } };
});

parameters.query:
UPDATE automation.device_profile
SET state = CASE WHEN $4 = 'yes' THEN 'queued' ELSE 'failed' END,
    command_uuid = CASE WHEN $4 = 'yes' THEN $3 ELSE NULL END,
    sent_at = now()
WHERE enrollment_id = $1 AND profile_name = $2
RETURNING enrollment_id, profile_name, state, $5::text AS detail

meta.description: Formular fuer das Hintergrundbild der iPads (Sperr- und Home-Bildschirm). Das Bild (PNG oder JPG, bis 4 MB, empfohlen 2048 x 2732) wird in automation.profile_state (Zeile wallpaper) gespeichert, die Version erhoeht und per MDM-Befehl Settings/Wallpaper (Where 3) an alle iPads gesendet. Neue iPads bekommen es ueber den Workflow Neues Geraet automatisch. Das Profil wallpaper-lock (allowWallpaperModification false) verhindert, dass Nutzer das Bild aendern und wird mitgesendet. Beides wirkt nur auf beaufsichtigten iPads. Credentials: MDM Formulare, MDM NanoMDM API, MDM Automation DB, ntfy-publisher.
